ground_feature_memory: normalized Tri-SIG-TIME SSL features of DURA(clean source) from training split
memory_targets: true L_s plus U_s clean-teacher pseudo-label if confidence >= .95
method: cosine nearest-neighbor voting and class centroids; direct classification diagnostic, no waveform reconstruction
caveat: Source target helper loads all L_s labels but evaluation labels are discarded before decisions; no U_s labels or Phase1 test data. Models saw source IDs; exploratory IDs may overlap other studies.
